en.headline: Police arrest 10 women in Tai Po, Sheung Shui and Fanling vice raids
en.dek: Tai Po officers and other departments searched four tenement subdivided flats on Thursday afternoon and arrested 10 mainland women on suspicion of breaching conditions of stay.
body: Tai Po district police, working with other departments, arrested 10 mainland women on Thursday afternoon in an operation against suspected unlawful prostitution, police said.

Officers searched a subdivided flat in a tenement on Kwong Fuk Road in Tai Po and arrested four women aged between 22 and 37. Six other women, aged between 25 and 45, were arrested in three similar flats on San Fung Road and San Fat Street in Sheung Shui and Luen On Street in Fanling. All were held on suspicion of breaching conditions of stay.
Police said the operation followed intelligence and further inquiries. The women were being detained for investigation.

zh.headline: 大埔上水粉嶺掃黃 四劍房拙10名內地女子
zh.dek: 大埔警區聯同相關部門周四下午在四個唐樓劍房採取行動，拑10名內地女子，涉嫌違反逗留條件。
body: 警方表示，大埔警區特別職務隊聯同相關部門根據線報及調查，周四下午在區內展開打擊非法賣淫行動，共拑10人。
人員在大埔廣福道一個唐樓劍房拑4名22至37歲內地女子，另在上水新豐路、新發街及粉嶺聯安街三個唐樓劍房拑6名25至45歲內地女子，全部涉嫌違反逗留條件。
警方指所有被捕人正被扣留調查。
